output.summary: KEP-4192 moves the Storage Version Migrator (SVM) controller in-tree into kube-controller-manager and moves its REST APIs in-tree under a new API group. Automatic migration is deferred to the user: the Migration resource is created manually rather than triggered automatically.
output.rationale: Rewriting stored data via no-op updates (kubectl get | kubectl replace) is impractical at scale, especially for large resources like secrets, and needs automation. The KEP keeps scope small by moving the existing out-of-tree controller in-tree and leaving automatic triggering to future work. Reviewers agreed on paginated lists for alpha, with the OOM/memory risk of watch-list or pagination to be resolved before beta.

alternatives.option: Use streaming watch (watch-list) for SVM's list operations in alpha
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers noted watch-list does not support pagination/continue tokens and the approach was unproven; wojtek-t later said the plan of record is to not use it even after alpha.

alternatives.option: Trigger migrations automatically from StorageVersion API hash changes
alternatives.why_not: Explicitly deferred: 'For Alpha, we will not trigger automatic storage version migration, and it will be deferred to the user.'

alternatives.option: Support continue tokens for resuming watch-list
alternatives.why_not: wojtek-t and logicalhan objected that resuming a watch-list with a continue token has subtly different semantics and gives users foot guns.

evidence.quote: Move the existing SVM controller logic in-tree into KCM from its [original source](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kube-storage-version-migrator).
Automatic storage version migration will be deferred to the user.
How about we stick with paginated list for alpha and add a beta graduation criteria line item like
Okay, I think this answers my question. Can we make it super clear in the KEP that there will be no automatic triggering
PRR looks good, but I think we agree that "on by default" (beta), requires resolving the "this may cause kube-apiserver OOMs and cascading failure even for pagination values due to memory explosion".
